name: Germanodactylus
isnote: Variously grouped with dsungaripteroids (Germanodactylidae) or with early ctenochasmatoids; Vidovic & Martill (2017) treat it as monotypic and moved ‘G. rhamphastinus’ to Altmuehlopterus.
sum: Crested pterodactyloid from the Late Jurassic Solnhofen limestones of Bavaria — the first pterosaur known to have a soft-tissue crest.
holotype: BSP 1892.IV.1 (G. cristatus) — Solnhofen limestone, Eichstätt, Bavaria.
material: Four specimens of G. cristatus, including two juveniles.
exceptional: Head crest with a low bony ridge and a soft-tissue part more than doubling its height.
biology: Sharply pointed jaw tip and robust teeth; a small predator of the Solnhofen lagoon.
author: Young 1964
